notes.construction: Linear interpolation of purchase rates on Macaulay duration across same-family securities; no extrapolation.
notes.breakeven: Market-implied inflation compensation (Fisher relation at equal duration). Includes inflation risk and liquidity premia; not a forecast.
notes.vol: Annualised std. dev. of daily changes over 63 observations, in bp.
notes.cleaning: 23 isolated one-day reversals in single securities and securities with less than 3 months of duration are excluded from these statistics; official quotes are otherwise used as published.
notes.gaps: Gaps mean no security spanned that duration on the date (e.g. no real bond beyond 20 years before 2010).
